authors: Coimbra JP, Collin SP, Hart NS
title: Topographic specializations in the retinal ganglion cell layer correlate with lateralized visual behavior, ecology, and evolution in cockatoos
why: Cockatoo retinal ganglion cell maps (abstract gives 52,000-72,000 cells/mm2 in the left eye of lateralized species); the abstract names no species, so it may include a black cockatoo. Would give an anatomical acuity for Zanda if it does. Already requested by sweep-12 for Cacatua.
get: journal via library (Wiley, J Comp Neurol)

authors: Chen Q, Wei Y, Hua B
title: Ultrastructural comparison of the compound eyes of Sinopanorpa and Panorpa (Mecoptera: Panorpidae)
why: Compares compound-eye ultrastructure across Panorpa species; may give interommatidial angles or facet sizes for further Panorpa species. Panorpa is already closed as g from P. dubia (Chen and Hua 2016), so this is an upgrade only.
